operations.summary: The News Category API lets you search on Bing and get back a list of top news articles by category. This section provides technical details about the query parameters and headers that you use to request news and the JSON response objects that contain them.  For examples that show how to make requests, see [Searching the web for news](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/bing-news-search/search-the-web).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] news category [PATH] news [PARAMS] accept agent apis bing category cc client count decorations edge format headline id img ip lang language location mkt ms offset original safe sdk search set text user x [SCHEMA] answer article news results search

operations.summary: The News Search API lets you send a search query to Bing and get back a list of news that are relevant to the search query. This section provides technical details about the query parameters and headers that you use to request news and the JSON response objects that contain them.  For examples that show how to make requests, see [Searching the web for news](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/bing-news-search/search-the-web).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] news search [PATH] news search [PARAMS] accept agent apis bing by cc client count decorations edge format freshness id img ip lang language location mkt ms offset original q safe sdk search set sort text user x [SCHEMA] answer article news results search

operations.summary: The News Trending Topics API lets you search on Bing and get back a list of trending news topics that are currently trending on Bing. This section provides technical details about the query parameters and headers that you use to request news and the JSON response objects that contain them.  For examples that show how to make requests, see [Searching the web for news](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/bing-news-search/search-the-web).
